title: Meeting of Old Friends
statementMd:
Today an outstanding event is going to happen in the forest — hedgehog Filya will come to his old fried Sonya!

Sonya is an owl and she sleeps during the day and stay awake from minute $*l*_{1}$ to minute $*r*_{1}$ inclusive. Also, during the minute $*k*$ she prinks and is unavailable for Filya.

Filya works a lot and he plans to visit Sonya from minute $*l*_{2}$ to minute $*r*_{2}$ inclusive.

Calculate the number of minutes they will be able to spend together.

## Input

The only line of the input contains integers $*l*_{1}$, $*r*_{1}$, $*l*_{2}$, $*r*_{2}$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{1}, *r*_{1}, *l*_{2}, *r*_{2}, *k* ≤ 10^{18}$, $*l*_{1} ≤ *r*_{1}$, $*l*_{2} ≤ *r*_{2}$), providing the segments of time for Sonya and Filya and the moment of time when Sonya prinks.

## Output

Print one integer — the number of minutes Sonya and Filya will be able to spend together.

## Note

In the first sample, they will be together during minutes $9$ and $10$.

In the second sample, they will be together from minute $50$ to minute $74$ and from minute $76$ to minute $100$.
statementZhMd:
今天，森林里将发生一件盛事——刺猬 Filya 要来见他的老朋友 Sonya！

Sonya 是一只猫头鹰，她白天睡觉，并且会从第 $*l*_{1}$ 分钟到第 $*r*_{1}$ 分钟（ inclusive）保持清醒。此外，在第 $*k*$ 分钟，她会打扮自己，无法与 Filya 见面。

Filya 工作非常忙，他计划从第 $*l*_{2}$ 分钟到第 $*r*_{2}$ 分钟（ inclusive）去拜访 Sonya。

请计算他们能够共度的分钟数。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含整数 $*l*_{1}$、$*r*_{1}$、$*l*_{2}$、$*r*_{2}$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *l*_{1}, *r*_{1}, *l*_{2}, *r*_{2}, *k* ≤ 10^{18}$，$*l*_{1} ≤ *r*_{1}$，$*l*_{2} ≤ *r*_{2}$），分别表示 Sonya 和 Filya 有空的时间段，以及 Sonya 打扮自己的时刻。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Sonya 和 Filya 能够共度的分钟数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，他们将在第 $9$ 分钟和第 $10$ 分钟共处。

在第二个样例中，他们将在第 $50$ 分钟到第 $74$ 分钟，以及第 $76$ 分钟到第 $100$ 分钟共处。
